item.question: How does feature selection impact model performance on ImageNet-1k when using different methods?
item.answer: On ImageNet-1k, ELF performs well with significantly reduced dimensionality compared to other methods like FSA and TISP. Although these traditional methods use all available features, they show diminishing returns in accuracy improvement as more features are added.
